visualCharacteristics: Searchable channel list with search field, Filter/Sorteren/Print controls and sliding filter and sort panels above rows of channel logos, numbers, names, packages and option icons.
contentPattern: Rows are classified by content: channel rows (logo picture | number + name paragraphs | package link list | option pictures), a filter row (package choices list | option choices list | reset + apply), a sort row (head paragraph + sort choices list) and a control row (search placeholder | action list | result heading).
usage: Use for an interactive, client-side searchable, filterable and sortable overview of TV channels.
reuseGuidance: Reuse only for channel or similar catalogue listings that need search, filter and sort; for static lists use a table or cards.
